title: Poland & CEE Channel Accelerator: Dedicated + Private Launch Brief
body:
Purpose:
This brief aligns GTM, sales, partner, and solutions engineering for a targeted Poland + Central & Eastern Europe (CEE) commercial push focused on Dedicated and Private deployment offerings. Goal: convert 8–12 pilot customers in the next 90 days and recruit 4 regional channel partners capable of delivering Dedicated deployments and integrations.

Executive positioning statement (one-liner):
Redwood Dedicated for CEE — predictable, private LLM inference with EU data residency, enterprise SLAs, and local partner delivery.

Why this region and timing:
- Rising demand for data-resident LLMs in regulated mid-market/enterprise verticals (finserv, health-tech, public sector).
- Competitors have either global cloud-only offerings (slower by contract and data residency) or fragmented open-source bundles requiring deep ops investment.
- Opportunity to lead with a combined offer: hosted-equivalent developer experience + on-prem/VPC controls and partner-enabled deployment services.

Top three customer benefits to emphasize:
1) Data residency + compliance: optional EU-only control plane, KMS/HSM integrations, audit logs for model usage.
2) Predictable economics: dedicated capacity commitments, transparent per-token throughput SLA, and quantization/optimize recommendations to reduce unit cost.
3) Local delivery capability: vetted partners for integration, networking, and ongoing ops support (reduces internal delivery time for customers).

Core messaging pillars (slide-ready bullets):
- Secure, private inference with enterprise SLAs — deploy where you need it.
- Same developer API across Hosted/Dedicated/Private — zero app changes when you move environments.
- Cost controls that scale — batching, KV caching, and per-route policies to cap spend.
- Local delivery and compliance — partners who know regional procurement and network ops.

Competitive notes (quick takeaways for AE/SE):
- Open-source self-host (Replicate/Mosaic-style): cheaper infra but high ops burden; call out Redwood's prebuilt runtime, autoscaling, kernel optimizations and support SLAs.
- Cloud incumbents (AWS/GCP/Azure/Bedrock): broad infra but slower to support EU private-control-plane patterns; emphasize Redwood's private control plane and faster model onboarding for inference.
- LLM API providers (OpenAI, Anthropic): great for rapid prototyping; highlight need for data residency and consistent latency at scale, plus cost controls and routing policies Redwood provides.

Objection scripts (sales):
- "We can self-host": "Totally — if you have an ops team, but most customers prefer predictable SLAs and a partner to handle upgrades, security patches, and kernel tweaks. We also provide a private control plane option so your team focuses on the app not infra."
- "Pricing feels high": "Compare unit economics: our Optimize toolkit typically reduces per-token costs by 20–40% across real workloads via batching and caching; combined with committed Dedicated pricing, net TCO is competitive with DIY runs."

Partner enablement checklist (for the 90-day sprint):
- Create a partner onboarding quickstart (SE-run): network prep, KMS wiring, model onboarding checklist.
- Build a one-click terraform module for edge/VPC peering templates.
- Host 2 partner workshops: delivery patterns + troubleshooting matrix.
- Provide pre-built demo app (finance-doc summarizer) localized to Polish sample data.

Launch artifacts and samples to ship this sprint:
- External announcement email template (see snippet below)
- AE battlecard with process maps and objection handling
- Technical runbook for SEs and partners (network, firewall, certs)
- Pricing cheatsheet for negotiations

Quick external announcement draft (subject + brief body snippet):
Subject: Redwood Dedicated now available with EU-private deployments and partner delivery in Poland/CEE
Hi {{first_name}},
We’re excited to announce a new Redwood Dedicated program for Poland and broader CEE — purpose-built for teams who need private, compliant LLM inference with local delivery partners. If you’re evaluating how to bring advanced LLM features into regulated products, we can run a 2-week pilot with guaranteed throughput targets and a partner-led deployment.

Internal enablement — one-pager summary for AE/SDR outreach:
- Target accounts: fintech with >10M monthly transactions, health-tech processing PHI-equivalent data, national/regional public sector orgs.
- Ideal champion: Head of Platform, Head of Data/AI, CIO
- Key ask for discovery call: existing LLM usage, latency/SLO targets, regulatory constraints, preferred procurement timeline.

Rollout timeline (high-level):
- Week 1–2: finalize partner agreements and publish partner quickstart docs.
- Week 3–4: train AE/SEs + run two partner workshops.
- Week 5–8: onboard first cohort of pilot customers (2–4).
- Week 9–12: evaluate pilots, iterate launch content, scale partner recruiting.

Metrics of success (90 days):
- Signed pilot commitments: 8–12
- Partner technical certifications: 4
- Conversion to paid Dedicated: >=30% of pilots

Open questions / Risks:
- Pricing sensitivity in SMB segment — may need two-tiered pricing (pilot-friendly vs full reserved).
- Legal review queue for public sector contracts in some countries may take 8+ weeks; flag early.
- Network procurement complexity (cross-border peering) — require SE pre-check template in discovery stage.

Next actions (owners):
- Maya: finalize AE battlecard and sample email (due 2025-02-20)
- Piotr: finalize partner quickstart + terraform module (due 2025-02-28)
- Lukas: coordinate 2 partner workshops and record sessions (due 2025-03-05)
- Aisha: prepare pricing cheatsheet with finance (due 2025-02-25)

Notes + references:
- See Confluence playbook (linked) for templates and previous regional launches.
- Slack channel for rapid questions: #gtm-emea (monitor during partner workshops).

Appendix: Suggested KPIs for pilot contracts (include as SLA addendum)
- 95th percentile tail latency by model and routing path
- Monthly token throughput guarantee and overage pricing
- Uptime SLA (target >= 99.9% for Dedicated)

Contact for questions: Maya Chen (mchen@redwood.ai)
